text: [Thread: The New Year is coming and I want to share a strong investment tip I practiced in 2025 and learnt from. Try following this in 2026.] I understand the sentiment and your passion behind the post. But again, I fail to understand the difference and strong way to be disciplined by your methodology. Also, automated SIPs tend to remove the manual emotional part from the investment equation. Automated investments can only be skipped or stoppes when the investor either has no money in the bank or they want to stop the investment. And that can happen while using your strategy too. In fact, making investments automated would help invest the planned amount. As per my gathered experience, manual intervention often defeats the purpose. With all due respect to your efforts, I am just trying to understand whether there is a difference between what you are posting and what is the general process.

Govt also milks taxes from common man at scale. So, what is great about the economy that we have to invest in India? If you remove homeland sentiment, the #'s don't lie.
